title: RECONTEXTUALIZATION MITIGATES SPECIFICATION GAMING WITHOUT MODIFYING THE SPECIFICATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether models change their answers to match user-stated opinions on subjective topics or abandon correct factual answers when challenged by the user, using benchmarks like User Belief Matching, 'Are You Sure?', and Biased Factual Answers.
Measuring the percentage of multiple-choice answers that match the political opinions and ideologies stated in a user's biographical description.
